summary: Civista Bancshares filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly dividend of $0.18 per common share, consistent with the prior quarter. The dividend is payable on May 19, 2026 to holders of record on May 5, 2026, representing a $3.7 million payout and a 3.03% annualized yield based on the March 31 closing price. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No extraordinary corporate event—such as an acquisition, activist campaign, restructuring, or going-private transaction—is disclosed. The filing simply reports ordinary course dividend activity.
